verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a task and agent-session orchestration platform. However, the evidence describes only single-item flows: running one task, one automation session, or one launch-token command. Multi-repository workspaces and Jira, GitHub, and Linear issue-to-task creation are related features, but none is documented as acting on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
